locator.name: clears the previous page chapters when the next ready pane renders none

proves.facet: A ready pane that renders no chapter clears the previous page's list instead of keeping it.

locator.name: lists the chapters the whole text renders beside the chapters the summary showed

proves.facet: Loading the whole text in place adds its chapters to the outline beside the summary's, with no navigation or remount.

1.note: Mounted reader controls cover typed commit/branch resolution retaining the prior selection on invalid input, truncated summary prose loading its whole text once with omitted deeper families explained, changed-prose and timeline snapshot mismatches refusing the new tree's bytes, continuation controls that restart or drop late side-loads after navigation, and the chapters the whole text lists beside the summary's. These are controlled component assertions, not a server timing result.
